tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. The pale underparts of the bird by day, a dusk field by night.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, sheets, popovers. Separate from surface-100 with a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100 / surface-200 (15:1). The cap black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface-100 / surface-200 (6.7:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3.4:1 light, 3.6:1 dark on surface-100).

tokens.name: wattle
tokens.usage: The signature accent: primary button fill, selected state, highlights. A FILL, never text or a thin line on light surfaces (1.4:1). On dark surfaces it may be text (11.8:1).

tokens.name: on-wattle
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on wattle (11:1). Always cap black, in both themes.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Upperparts brown. Large fills, illustration, chart series 1. As text only at 24px+ (4.2:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: taupe
tokens.usage: Neck-and-breast grey-brown. Quiet fills, tags, chart series 2. Not for text on light surfaces (2.5:1).

tokens.name: wing
tokens.usage: Wing-tip dark brown. Deep bands, footers, tooltips; pair with surface-100 light text (9.8:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, as text or icon on surface-100 (5.5:1 light, 7.2:1 dark). Keep small — state only.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Overlines, tags, button labels in small sizes. Set in uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, form field spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips — round like the eye ring.
